prompts.title: Full-Stack WP Developer
prompts.description: Full-Stack WP Developer: plan, build, extend, verify, and review WordPress themes, plugins, add-ons, and Core patches across the full development lifecycle. Fill in the task and run Full-Stack WP Developer in one step.
prompts.content:
# Full-Stack WP Developer

Run /fswp-developer and help me with the task below. Talk to me in plain words and ask only what you need from me.

* **Task:** `{{task}}`
* **Stage:** `{{stage}}`
* **Files:** `{{files}}`
* **Details:** `{{details}}`

If something you need is missing, ask for it in one short message, then continue.

Before you create, change, send, publish, or delete anything, show a short plan and wait for my yes. Read-only checks run without it.

task.label: Task
task.placeholder: Describe what you need in your own words.
task.context: What goes in, what should come out, and any rules it must follow.

stage.label: Stage
stage.context: Pick the step to run. Not sure: leave it on the first option and the entry skill decides. Skills: FSWP API Developer = /fswp-developer:fswp-api-developer; FSWP Architect = /fswp-developer:fswp-architect; FSWP Block Developer = /fswp-developer:fswp-block-developer; FSWP Core Contributor = /fswp-developer:fswp-core-contributor; FSWP DevOps Engineer = /fswp-developer:fswp-devops-engineer; FSWP Maintainer = /fswp-developer:fswp-maintainer; FSWP Performance Engineer = /fswp-developer:fswp-performance-engineer; FSWP Plugin Developer = /fswp-developer:fswp-plugin-developer; FSWP QA Engineer = /fswp-developer:fswp-qa-engineer; FSWP Release Manager = /fswp-developer:fswp-release-manager; FSWP Reviewer = /fswp-developer:fswp-reviewer; FSWP Security Engineer = /fswp-developer:fswp-security-engineer; FSWP Theme Developer = /fswp-developer:fswp-theme-developer.
